en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Не претезај ... половина' is my reading and uncertain. The second half is the girl's reply, telling the boy how to raise the money to buy her. Origin unclear.

lines.en: Don't overreach, Jovka, hey, by half,
don't overreach, my dear, hey, by half.
Next to me, Jovka, hey, is bachelor life,
next to me, Jovka, hey, is shepherd life.

lines.cyr: Немам пари, Јовке мори, да те купам,
lines.lat: Nemam pari, Jovke mori, da te kupam,
lines.en: I have no money, Jovka, hey, to buy you,

lines.cyr: немам пари, Јовке мори, да те купам.
lines.lat: nemam pari, Jovke mori, da te kupam.
lines.en: I have no money, Jovka, hey, to buy you.

lines.cyr: - Па и тој ли, лудо море, да те учам!
lines.lat: - Pa i toj li, ludo more, da te učam!
lines.en: - And must I teach you even that, foolish one!

lines.cyr: Продај трло, лудо море, сосе стадо,
lines.lat: Prodaj trlo, ludo more, sose stado,
lines.en: Sell the sheepfold, foolish one, with the flock,

lines.cyr: продај лозје, лудо море, сосе грозје,
lines.lat: prodaj lozje, ludo more, sose grozje,
lines.en: sell the vineyard, foolish one, with the grapes,

lines.cyr: продај коња, лудо море, сосе седло.
lines.lat: prodaj konja, ludo more, sose sedlo.
lines.en: sell the horse, foolish one, with the saddle.

lines.cyr: Земи пари, лудо море, купи мене,
lines.lat: Zemi pari, ludo more, kupi mene,
lines.en: Take the money, foolish one, buy me,

lines.cyr: води дома, лудо море, за невеста.
lines.lat: vodi doma, ludo more, za nevesta.
lines.en: take me home, foolish one, as your bride.
